eps.d: Romeo now openly enjoys his affair with Indy, having accepted it's not the same as with Annie. Prince Vittorio wastes no time moving onto the ground rival Liam abandoned, taking Bianca to dinner and handling the press by confirming he came to Australia for her. Dex forgives Mitzy, whom Sid grudgingly treats in hospital, now Marilyn told them she's terminal. - Written by KGF Vissers

Angelo takes Alf's advice not to keep secrets with his lover, but when Carlie hears he was attracted to younger Shandi Ayres, even though he did nothing, she jealously, spitefully walks out on him. After a gloomy day in Miles's class with gold-fish Marilyn, Dex returns the substitute sweetheart to the pet shop, which leads to date with its Goth clerk Adrian Hall.
Dexter goes on a date with Adrian, Romeo encourages Indigo to contact her mum and a dying Mitzy has differing revelations for Marilyn and Sid.
While Marilyn has to cope with Mitzy's funeral, Dexter tries to make things up with Adrian and Ruby persuades Charlie to give her a driving lesson.

Romeo tries to have faith in Indy, but she 'lost',actually stole, a letter from his ex Annie, and ignores paternal advice by steam-opening it before 'finding' and returning it. Palmer tries again to convince Gina his proposal was sincere, not last choice, but is disgusted by her reaction and decides to move out. - Written by KGF Vissers
